reviews.title: Peso y calidad
reviews.comment: Muy buena calidad y es muy compacto para armar un pc mini itx
reviews.author: javier

reviews.title: ITX Beast
reviews.comment: I build this in a Fractal Design ITX case. There is plenty of connection on the board, I was kinda of rough with the installation and made some mistakes, Despite this the board lasted and didn't get any damage. The interface of the Bios is easy to navigate and overall great board. I would say on par with ASUS Strix even.
reviews.author: Jin

reviews.title: Wouldn’t even start
reviews.comment: I took all precautions and motherboard would not power on. Not even indicator LEDs. Tried with a couple different PSUs that I verified were working. Took everything apart and double checked all connections. This board arrived dead.
reviews.author: D. H. Christian
